issues.issue: Query without pagination - getPlaylists() fetches ALL playlists and lacks orderBy optimization
issues.recommendation: Implement pagination with limit() and startAfter() for large user libraries. Add index on (userId, createdAt).
issues.impact: Could cause performance degradation with 100+ playlists

issues.issue: addSongToPlaylist() fetches entire playlist array, modifies in memory, and writes back - inefficient for large playlists
issues.current_code: final songs = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(existing.data()?['songs'] ?? []); ... await ref.update({'songs': songs});
issues.recommendation: Use Firestore arrayUnion/arrayRemove instead of fetch-modify-write pattern. Store as subcollection for 100+ songs.
issues.impact: Write throttling, increased latency, race conditions with concurrent updates

issues.issue: toggleLike() uses individual arrayUnion/arrayRemove calls - could batch multiple likes into single write
issues.recommendation: Implement batch write for multiple likes. Consider denormalizing like count for quick aggregation.
issues.impact: Higher write load, slower UI feedback

issues.issue: fetchUser() queries Firestore on every auth state change without caching
issues.current_code: Future<UserModel?> fetchUser(String uid) async { final doc = await _db.collection('users').doc(uid).get(); }
issues.recommendation: Cache user data in memory with TTL. Use Firestore onSnapshot listener for real-time sync instead of repeated queries.
issues.impact: Unnecessary Firestore reads, unused read quota

issues.issue: No batch operations for bulk playlist operations (create multiple, delete multiple)
issues.recommendation: Add batch{Create,Delete,Update}Playlists() methods using WriteBatch API
issues.impact: Multiple RPC calls instead of single batch

issues.issue: No composite key indexing for user queries (uid + createdAt for sorting)
issues.recommendation: Create Firestore composite indexes: users (uid, createdAt DESC)
issues.impact: Query performance degradation with scale

issues.issue: _Placeholder widget recreated on every frame - no const/memoization
issues.recommendation: Make _Placeholder() const or use Shimmer widget for better UX. Cache placeholder widgets.
issues.impact: Unnecessary widget rebuilds and memory churn

issues.issue: CachedNetworkImage loaded twice for same song (tile + bottom sheet) without proper cache key
issues.current_code: CachedNetworkImage(imageUrl: song.imageUrl, ...) used in multiple widgets
issues.recommendation: Use CachedNetworkImageProvider with custom cache key manager. Pre-warming cache on song list load.
issues.impact: Duplicate cache entries, higher memory usage

issues.issue: No image resolution/size optimization - loading full resolution images for thumbnails
issues.current_code: CachedNetworkImage(imageUrl: song.imageUrl, width: 200, height: 200, fit: BoxFit.cover)
issues.recommendation: Use image URL parameters to request specific resolution. Example: imageUrl + '?w=200&h=200&q=80'
issues.impact: Higher bandwidth usage, slower image loads

issues.issue: CachedNetworkImageProvider used with large image in blur backdrop without size constraints
issues.recommendation: Add maxWidth, maxHeight to image cache configuration. Use smaller version for blur effect.
issues.impact: Increased memory footprint for decorative images

issues.issue: SVG assets mentioned in pubspec.yaml but PNG duplicates exist (app_icon.png vs vibelo_icon_1024.png)
issues.current_code: flutter_svg dependency imported; PNG files in assets/icon/ and assets/icons/
issues.recommendation: Consolidate to single format. Consider WebP for app_icon (11KB -> ~7KB). Use SVG for vectors.
issues.impact: Asset bloat, minor size increase

issues.issue: Queue album art uses full-size image in horizontal scroll list
issues.current_code: CachedNetworkImage(...) in GridView/ListView without lazy loading optimization
issues.recommendation: Limit image dimensions to 80x80 for queue. Load on demand with precaching.
issues.impact: Memory spike with large queues (100+ songs)

issues.issue: Monolithic 740-line screen with multiple responsibilities - player UI, queue management, equalizer, sleep timer
issues.current_code: class _PlayerScreenState extends State<PlayerScreen> with TickerProviderStateMixin { ... Widget build() { ... } }
issues.recommendation: Extract into: PlayerHeader (100 lines), AlbumArt (80 lines), Controls (120 lines), Queue (200 lines), Equalizer (100 lines), SleepTimer (80 lines)
issues.impact: Hard to maintain, slow hot reload, performance issues with animations

issues.issue: 524-line screen with embedded banner, grids, and shimmer loaders in main build method
issues.recommendation: Move to separate widget files (featured_banner.dart, mood_grid.dart, genre_grid.dart)
issues.impact: Slow IDE responsiveness, complex git diffs

issues.issue: 445-line screen mixes music library, playlist management, and tab logic
issues.recommendation: Extract tabs to separate files with proper state management
issues.impact: Difficult to reuse tab components elsewhere

issues.issue: DraggableScrollableSheet with SingleChildScrollView causing multiple scroll contexts
issues.current_code: Column with 12+ children, deeply nested SingleChildScrollView + DraggableScrollableSheet
issues.recommendation: Refactor to use SliverList/CustomScrollView for efficient scrolling
issues.impact: Scroll jank, poor performance with animations

issues.issue: SongTile widget handles play, like, options, share, add-to-playlist, add-to-queue - too many responsibilities
issues.current_code: 280+ line widget with multiple bottom sheets and dialogs embedded
issues.recommendation: Separate into SongTile (display) + SongTileActions (modal factory)
issues.impact: Hard to test, reuse, or maintain

issues.issue: Search TextField with setState() on every keystroke - no debouncing
issues.recommendation: Add 300ms debounce with Timer or use rxdart package
issues.impact: Triggers excessive API calls during typing

issues.issue: google_fonts imported in 9 files but loaded from network by ThemeData every app start
issues.current_code: GoogleFonts.poppins used in screens/home_screen.dart, screens/player_screen.dart, widgets/song_tile.dart, etc.
issues.recommendation: Use TextTheme preset in AppTheme + define const TextStyle for common cases. Lazy-load google_fonts only if needed.
issues.impact: Network latency on app startup, larger APK size

issues.issue: uuid package imported but only used for playlist ID generation - could use timestamp + hash
issues.recommendation: Replace with: '${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_${Random().nextInt(10000)}'.hashCode
issues.impact: Tiny size reduction, no functional impact

issues.issue: share_plus package imported but used only in one callback
issues.recommendation: Platform-check import or lazy import only when needed
issues.impact: Minor size increase (share_plus adds ~200KB to APK)

issues.issue: shimmer package imported but only used for loading placeholders in home_screen
issues.recommendation: Use native Flutter shimmer pattern or conditional import
issues.impact: APK size: shimmer adds ~100KB

issues.issue: Unused imports detected - verify all screen imports are used
issues.current_code: Multiple screens import unused services or providers
issues.recommendation: Run 'dart analyze' and remove unused imports. Use Dart lint rules.
issues.impact: Code cleanliness, minor build time improvement

issues.issue: PNG assets not optimized - vibelo_icon_playstore_512.png (24.3KB) larger than necessary
issues.current_code:
vibelo_icon_playstore_512.png - 24,364 bytes
vibelo_icon_preview_192.png - 8,443 bytes
icon/vibelo_icon_1024.png - 11,719 bytes
icons/app_icon.png - 11,719 bytes
issues.recommendation: Convert to WebP format: expect 40-50% size reduction. Use single source file with density variants. Remove duplicates.
issues.impact: APK size reduction: ~8-12KB

issues.issue: Duplicate app icon files in two directories (icons/ and icon/)
issues.current_code: vibelo_icon_1024.png listed in both assets/icon/ and assets/icons/
issues.recommendation: Consolidate to single directory. Update pubspec.yaml assets section.
issues.impact: Removes redundancy, improves maintainability

issues.issue: Icon generation configuration includes both Android and iOS but not adaptive icons for Android 8+
issues.current_code: android: true, ios: true (no adaptive icon config)
issues.recommendation: Add adaptive icon support to reduce APK size and improve consistency
issues.impact: Better Android integration, minor size benefit

issues.issue: Widget watches entire PlayerProvider and AuthProvider instead of specific fields - rebuilds on any change
issues.current_code:
final player = context.watch<PlayerProvider>();
final auth = context.watch<AuthProvider>();
issues.recommendation: Use Selector to watch only: isPlaying, currentSongId from PlayerProvider; isLiked from AuthProvider
issues.example_fix: final isPlaying = context.select<PlayerProvider, bool>((p) => p.isPlaying && p.currentSong?.id == song.id);
issues.impact: Rebuilds 10+ times per interaction instead of necessary rebuilds

issues.issue: toggleLike() calls notifyListeners() twice - once for local update, once after Firebase write
issues.current_code: optimistic update: notifyListeners(); await Firebase op; (implicit listener again on state change)
issues.recommendation: Single notifyListeners() call after successful Firebase write. Use try-catch for rollback.
issues.impact: Double rebuilds, increased rendered frame count

issues.issue: Watches entire MusicProvider even when only displaying trending list - rebuilds on all music changes
issues.recommendation: Use Selector: context.select<MusicProvider, List<SongModel>>((m) => m.trending);
issues.impact: Unnecessary rebuilds during search, genre load, etc.

issues.issue: Watches entire MusicProvider but only uses searchResults - rebuilds on trending/new releases load
issues.recommendation: Use Selector to watch only searchResults list
issues.impact: Unnecessary widget rebuilds

issues.issue: loadHomeData() sets multiple boolean flags with individual notifyListeners() calls
issues.recommendation: Batch state updates: set all flags, then single notifyListeners()
issues.impact: Double rebuilds during home screen load

issues.issue: Uses setState() for local playlist loading instead of Provider - mixing state management patterns
issues.recommendation: Move to LocalPlaylistProvider or MusicProvider for consistency
issues.impact: Inconsistent patterns, harder to test

issues.issue: PlayerProvider watched in build method multiple times - no memoization of derived values
issues.recommendation: Add computed getters in PlayerProvider: isCurrentSongPlaying, progressPercent, etc.
issues.impact: Repeated calculations, widget rebuilds
